task.title: M3: Resolve workspace package imports to in-repo files
task.description:
In a monorepo, imports of sibling workspace packages (for example packages/cli importing @codeviz/core) resolve through a node_modules symlink, so both TS resolvers report them as external packages and the dependency graph has no edges between packages. On codeviz itself the collapsed top-level graph is empty and the compare edges view only shows intra-package edges. Make both resolvers return a file resolution when the target lives inside the analyzed repo: the precise resolver should realpath the resolved file and treat it as in-repo when the real path is under the repo root and contains no node_modules segment (preferring a tracked .ts/.tsx source over a .d.ts); the baseline resolver should read the root package.json workspaces globs, map each workspace package name to its directory, and resolve bare specifiers name and name/subpath against it (package.json main/module/exports entry, then index.ts, src/index.ts, and extension probing for subpaths).

Acceptance criteria:
- Analyzing codeviz itself yields file-level edges from packages/cli and packages/analyzers to packages/core, and from packages/web to packages/core, with both the precise and the baseline resolver.
- The top-level collapsed graph of codeviz shows aggregated edges between the packages compound children.
- Real third-party packages (react, node:fs, typescript) still resolve as external, and the Capacitor edge count does not drop.
- Fixture tests cover a workspace import in both resolvers, including a subpath import and a package whose main points at src/index.ts.
